# Textit

TextIt is a platform that enables users to build scalable, interactive chatbots across various channels without writing code.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/textit/.

## Actions

- **Create Campaign**: Create a new campaign in textit.
- **Create Contact Group**: Create a new contact group.
- **Create Label**: Create a new message label.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete an existing contact.
- **Delete Contact Group**: Delete an existing contact group.
- **Get Campaign**: Retrieve details about a specific campaign.
- **List Archives**: Retrieve a list of message and run archives.
- **List Broadcasts**: List broadcasts.
- **List Campaign Events**: Retrieve a list of campaign events.
- **List Campaigns**: List campaigns.
- **List Channels**: List channels.
- **List Contacts**: Retrieve a list of contacts.
- **List custom contact fields**: Retrieve a list of custom contact fields.
- **List Flow Starts**: Retrieve a list of manual flow starts.
- **List Globals**: List global variables.
- **List Groups**: List contact groups.
- **List Labels**: Retrieve a list of message labels.
- **List Runs**: Retrieve a list of flow runs.
- **List Topics**: List topics in the workspace.
- **Send Broadcast**: Send a new broadcast message.
- **Update Contact**: Update an existing contact.
